A '''test ideal''' is a positive characteristic analog of a [[multiplier ideal]] in, say, the field of complex numbers.<ref>{{Cite arXiv |eprint = 1407.4324|last1 = Henriques|first1 = Inês B.|last2 = Varbaro|first2 = M.|title = Test, multiplier and invariant ideals|year = 2014|class = math.AC}}</ref> Test ideals are used in the study of singularities in algebraic geometry in positive characteristic.<ref>{{cite book|title=A Celebration of Algebraic Geometry|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=4UDeAAAAQBAJ|last1=Hassett|first1=Brendan|author-link=Brendan Hassett|last2=McKernan|first2=James|author-link2=James McKernan|last3=Starr|first3=Jason|last4=Vakil|first4=Ravi|author-link4=Ravi Vakil|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|date=September 11, 2013|isbn=9780821889831|access-date=3 March 2017}}</ref>
